examples.text: Кого она сейчас на самом деле любит?
examples.trans: Who does she really love right now?

examples.text: Скажи честно, ты раньше в тюрьме сидел?
examples.trans: Tell me honestly, were you in prison before?

examples.text: Да, я там немного совсем посидел.
examples.trans: Yes, I spent just a little time there.

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Просто подойди к ней и спроси.
examples.trans: Just walk up to her and ask.

examples.text: Слушай, может быть, я просто уеду?
examples.trans: Listen, maybe I will just go away?

examples.text: В его возрасте такое непросто нарисовать.
examples.trans: At his age it is not easy to draw something like this.

meanings.en: to come up to, to approach
meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'ойти'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'approach, go up', paired with 'подходить'.

examples.text: Просто подойди к ней и спроси.
examples.trans: Just walk up to her and ask.

examples.text: Потом спокойно подойдёшь и скажешь всем.
examples.trans: Then you will calmly walk up and tell everyone.

examples.text: Подойди ко мне!
examples.trans: Come here to me!

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian spatial or relational preposition meaning 'to, towards', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Это мне сегодня Настя рассказала.
examples.trans: Nastya told me this today.

examples.text: Теперь у нас точно всё кончено.
examples.trans: Now everything is definitely over between us.

examples.text: Ты так сильно расстроился из-за этого?
examples.trans: Did you get so upset because of this?

meanings.en: to ask (a question, or someone: спросить у кого-то)
meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'просить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'ask', paired with 'спрашивать'.

examples.text: Просто подойди к ней и спроси.
examples.trans: Just walk up to her and ask.

examples.text: Извините, я зашёл только быстро спросить.
examples.trans: Excuse me, I came in just to ask quickly.

examples.text: А спросите у него, куда он дел компьютерный класс.
examples.trans: Ask him where he put the computer lab.
